subject: 專業英文

essays.text: 請將下列英文譯為中文：（25 分）Propeller excitation is far more difficult to quantify than the excitation from internalmachinery sources. This is because of the complexity of the unsteady hydrodynamics ofthe propeller operating in the non-uniform hull wake. In fact, the non-uniform hull wake isthe most complicated part; unfortunately it is also the most important part. Propellerinduced vibration would never be considered in ship design if the propeller disk inflow iscircumferentially uniform. Any treatment of propeller excitation must begin with considerationof the hull wake.

請將下列中文譯為英文：
①自國外輸入之船舶，其原丈量模式與中華民國丈量模式相同者，免予重行丈量。（6 分）
②自國外輸入之船舶，其原丈量模式與中華民國丈量模式不同者，仍應依規定申請丈量；船舶所有人於申請丈量、領有噸位證書前，得憑原船籍國之噸位證明文件，先行申請核發臨時船舶國籍證書。（12 分）
③若發現丈量之船舶噸位與其噸位證書記載不符時，該航政機關得依據實際丈量結果，更換其噸位證書。（7 分）
